timing: Retrospective: created after answers were available. Not preregistered; same criteria applied to both conditions. Q11/16/18 retain the preceding core-fact checklist.

correctness.2: No substantive error identified in reviewed answer claims/examples
correctness.1: Usable core answer with a substantive factual error
correctness.0: Core answer is wrong or unusable

completeness.1: Useful answer with at least one listed essential fact omitted/partial
completeness.0: Fails to address the main task

citation_support.2: Essential assertions made in the answer are grounded in relevant cited source blocks
citation_support.1: At least one essential assertion made lacks relevant citation support
citation_support.0: Absent or materially misleading source grounding

citation_policy: A definition-start link may identify the enclosing source block; a bare line is not automatically a claim that only that one line contains all support. This is answer-level essential-claim assessment, not exhaustive per-sentence entailment. Structural link checks are separate.
optional_policy: More length, extra examples, test subclasses and peripheral details do not improve scores once essential facts are covered. Missing optional facts are recorded but not penalized.
